reset_fee: CFD: reset priced as a multiple of what you paid — 1-Step phase 1 0.85x / funded 1.15x; 2-Step 0.85x / 1.15x / funded 1.55x; Instant 0.85x; Access $5 (funded 1.55x funded fee); offer valid 7 days after breach. Futures: evaluation reset 90% of price paid (one per evaluation); funded reactivation once at 3x plan price; Direct cannot be reset.
refund_policy: Used (traded) accounts non-refundable; unused accounts may be refunded within 7 days at Atlas discretion. Evaluation fee returned with 3rd funded payout (1-Step/2-Step/Daily), 4th (Access), 5th (Instant). Add-ons never refunded.
min_payout: $100 profit ($50 on 1-Step/2-Step Daily); futures min request $500 on $50K; trading-rules page states $3,000 minimum for crypto withdrawals
scaling_plan: Pricing cards mention 'Scaling plan as you grow'; no published scaling schedule found. Futures: risk review at 5th payout may refer trader to Atlas Live.
max_risk_per_trade: Atlas Protector on funded CFD accounts: net floating loss of 2% of initial balance closes all positions (split cut to 50%); second trigger breaches. Using >80% of balance on one trade treated as gambling. Futures max position e.g. 4 minis / 40 micros on $50K.
inactivity_rule: At least one trade every 30 days or the account may be closed
notes: activation_fee 0 for normal programs; Access instead charges a funded fee on pass ($52-$1,739 by size). Copy trading allowed only between your own Atlas accounts; copying others prohibited. Hedging between own Atlas accounts permitted on CFD per trading rules, but risk-free cross-account/cross-firm hedging prohibited; futures FAQ says long+short across own accounts not allowed. Add-ons (+20% each): On-Demand payout, Weekly payout, No minimum trading days, 100% split; bundles +45-50%. KYC via Veriff before first payout.
